Help.Positive.Title: Positive
Help.Positive.Text: Dark parts of the picture become thick, bright parts thin. The usual choice: the lit print looks like the photo.
Help.Negative.Title: Negative
Help.Negative.Text: Bright parts become thick and dark parts thin, so the lit print looks like a negative. Useful for white-on-black artwork.
Help.Mirror.Title: Mirror
Help.Mirror.Text: Flips the picture left ↔ right. Use it when the lithophane will be viewed from the other side, e.g. from inside a lamp.
Help.Flip.Title: Flip
Help.RepeatX.Title: Repeat X
Help.RepeatX.Text: Repeats the picture side by side this many times across the width. Handy for patterns around a lamp.
Help.RepeatY.Title: Repeat Y
Help.RepeatY.Text: Repeats the picture this many times from bottom to top.
Help.Gamma.Title: Contrast (gamma)
Help.Gamma.Text: Curve applied to the brightness before it becomes thickness. 1 = unchanged. Above 1 darkens the mid-tones (more contrast in bright areas); below 1 brightens them.
Help.Rotate.Title: Rotate image 90°
Help.Rotate.Text: Rotates the picture a quarter turn clockwise each click. The rotation is saved in the project.
Help.Shape.Title: Shape
Help.Shape.Text: The overall form. Flat and the two curves are panels. Cylinder, heart and dome wrap the picture all the way around and are meant to go over a light.
Help.MaxSize.Title: Maximum size
Help.MaxSize.Text: Length of the picture's longest side in mm, without the border. For curved and closed shapes it is measured along the curve: for a cylinder the width becomes the circumference.
Help.Thickness.Title: Thickness
Help.Thickness.Text: Wall thickness of the darkest areas and of the border. Thicker gives darker darks and a sturdier print. 3 mm is typical.
Help.MinThickness.Title: Thinnest layer
Help.MinThickness.Text: Wall thickness of the brightest areas. Thinner gives brighter highlights but a fragile print; keep at least two nozzle widths (about 0.8 mm for a 0.4 mm nozzle).
Help.Border.Title: Border
Help.Border.Text: Solid frame around the picture at full thickness. It gives the print strength and is what sits in the slot of a light support. On closed shapes it is only added at the top and bottom.
Help.Resolution.Title: Resolution
Help.Resolution.Text: Mesh points per mm in each direction. 5 points/mm (0.2 mm spacing) matches a 0.4 mm nozzle; more only makes the STL file larger.
Help.CurveAngle.Title: Curve angle
Help.CurveAngle.Text: How far the outer or inner curve bends, in degrees. 90° is a gentle quarter circle, 180° a half circle.
Help.StandDepth.Title: Stand depth
Help.StandDepth.Text: Front-to-back depth of a foot under the bottom edge so the panel stands on its own. 0 = no stand. Not used together with a light support.
Help.StandHeight.Title: Stand height
Help.LightSource.Title: Light source
Help.LightSource.Text: Generates a base that holds the lithophane in a slot and houses the light: a channel or tray for an LED strip / string, or a round recess or hole for a lamp.
Help.SupportHeight.Title: Base height
Help.SupportHeight.Text: Total height of the base. It is raised automatically if the cable groove would not fit underneath.
Help.SlotDepth.Title: Slot depth
Help.SlotDepth.Text: How deep the lithophane sits in the base. Keep the border at least this tall so no part of the picture is hidden.
Help.SlotClearance.Title: Slot clearance
Help.SlotClearance.Text: Extra gap on each side of the lithophane inside the slot. Printers vary: increase it if the print does not fit, reduce it if it wobbles.
Help.SupportWall.Title: Wall thickness
Help.SupportWall.Text: Thickness of the base walls, including the wall between the slot and the light.
Help.SupportMinDepth.Title: Min. base depth
Help.SupportMinDepth.Text: Minimum front-to-back depth of the base so a panel cannot tip over. Only for flat and curved panels; closed shapes use their own footprint.
Help.CableDiameter.Title: Cable hole
Help.CableDiameter.Text: Diameter of the hole for the power cable. It leads down to a groove under the base, so the base still sits flat with the cable in place.
Help.LedChannelWidth.Title: LED channel width
Help.LedChannelWidth.Text: Width of the channel behind a panel that the LED strip lies in. Closed shapes get a tray over the whole inside instead.
Help.LedChannelDepth.Title: LED channel depth
Help.LedChannelDepth.Text: Depth of the channel (or tray) below the top of the base. Deeper hides the LEDs better; it is limited by the base height.
Help.LampPreset.Title: Lamp type
Help.LampPreset.Text: Common light sources with their sizes. Tea light and LED puck sit in a recess; E14 / E27 sockets and the M10 tube go through the base. Custom keeps your own values.
Help.LampDiameter.Title: Lamp hole diameter
Help.LampDiameter.Text: Diameter of the round recess or hole for the lamp, including a little play. For closed shapes it is reduced automatically if it would not fit inside the lithophane.
Help.LampDepth.Title: Recess depth
Help.LampDepth.Text: How deep the recess is, measured from the top of the base. Ignored for through-holes.
Help.LampThrough.Title: Hole through the base
Help.LampThrough.Text: Makes the hole go all the way through, for lamp sockets and threaded tubes that are fixed from below.
Help.ShowLight.Title: Show the light source
Help.ShowLight.Text: Draws the light itself in the 3D preview (LED strip, tea light or bulb) so you can see where it sits. It is never part of the exported STL.
Help.Layout.Title: Export as
Help.Layout.Text: How the two parts are written: separate STL files (each with its own print settings), one file with both parts side by side, or one file with the lithophane already standing in the base, printed as one piece.
Help.Backlit.Title: Backlit view
Help.Backlit.Text: Simulates light shining through the print instead of normal shading: thin areas glow, thick areas stay dark.
Help.LightColor.Title: Light colour
Help.LightColor.Text: Colour of the light behind the print: warm or cool white, a colour, or any custom colour from the swatch.
Help.LightPower.Title: Light power
Help.LightPower.Text: Brightness of the light. 100 % is a typical LED strip or lamp; raise it to see what a stronger light would do.
Help.Filament.Title: Filament colour
Help.Filament.Text: Colour of the filament you will print with, for a solid (100 % infill) print. Coloured filament blocks the other colours, so thick areas turn into a deep version of its colour.
Sketch.solidFrame: solid frame at full thickness, all round
Sketch.maxSizeLongest: Maximum size = longest side of the picture
Sketch.viewedFromAbove: viewed from above (dome: from the side)
Sketch.facesOutwards: picture faces outwards; cylinder, heart and dome go over a light
Sketch.curveCaption: picture length stays the same; the angle sets how tight it bends
Sketch.ledStripBehind: LED strip in a channel behind
Sketch.samePrint: same print, stronger light = brighter picture
Sketch.litThin: lit: thin glows, thick is deep colour
